summary: Registered the single premise that keeps the worker-panic question open: whether the goroutine that runs an engine worker invokes the worker function under a deferred recover or calls it directly. The target-side facts (engine launching workers through a stopper, the snapshot save path panicking with no recover in the worker body, and the only target recover sites) are already recorded, and the dependency reading is deliberately not promoted to target evidence. No new interpretation or execution this turn.
